      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\zapabob\\2025-10-23_semver_sync_and_fast_build_log.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2025-10-23 SemVer Sync &amp; Release Build Improvements Log",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- Aligned all workspace/package metadata with the upstream OpenAI/codex semantic version (&#96;0.48.0&#96;) by stripping the &#96;-zapabob.1&#96; suffix.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- Propagated the version change across Rust workspace manifests, npm package metadata, global installer messaging, and user-agent strings to ensure consistent branding.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Introduced a shared &#96;resolve_runtime_budget&#96; helper for CLI commands so runtime token budgets inherit the canonical integer type and clamping logic without duplication.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Brought the &#96;research_cmd&#96; Gemini integration back in line with the upstream API surface (using existing constructors) while retaining informative logs for MCP fallbacks.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- Added the missing &#96;codex-stdio-to-uds&#96; dependency reference so the CLI links its stdio tunnel helper during release builds.",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- Normalised the DeepResearch web search user-agent string to the upstream format.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Details",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96;: Set &#96;[workspace.package] version = \"0.48.0\"&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-cli/package.json&#96;: Bumped &#96;version&#96; to &#96;\"0.48.0\"&#96; for the npm artefact.",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;scripts/install/global-install.ps1&#96;: Report the installed version dynamically instead of the hard-coded &#96;0.47.0-alpha.1&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/lib.rs&#96;: Added &#96;resolve_runtime_budget&#96; utility used by all CLI subcommands that instantiate &#96;AgentRuntime&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;{agent_create_cmd.rs, delegate_cmd.rs, parallel_delegate_cmd.rs}&#96;: Switched to the helper and kept token budgets as &#96;i64&#96;, matching upstream expectations.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml&#96;: Declared &#96;codex_stdio_to_uds&#96; workspace dependency to restore linkage.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs&#96;: Replaced unsupported Gemini constructors with &#96;new&#96;/&#96;with_mcp_client&#96; pattern while logging MCP intention; maintained provider fallback order.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/web_search_provider.rs&#96;: Updated the HTTP user-agent to &#96;Mozilla/5.0 Codex-DeepResearch/0.48.0&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cargo build --release&#96; (workspace root) — ✅ (after dependency + helper fixes).",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;scripts/install/global-install.ps1&#96; — ✅ produces globally installed CLI reporting &#96;codex-cli 0.48.0&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.43306851387023926
    },

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 2025-10-23 SemVer Sync &amp; Release Build Improvements Log",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- Aligned all workspace/package metadata with the upstream OpenAI/codex semantic version (&#96;0.48.0&#96;) by stripping the &#96;-zapabob.1&#96; suffix.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- Propagated the version change across Rust workspace manifests, npm package metadata, global installer messaging, and user-agent strings to ensure consistent branding.",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Introduced a shared &#96;resolve_runtime_budget&#96; helper for CLI commands so runtime token budgets inherit the canonical integer type and clamping logic without duplication.",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- Brought the &#96;research_cmd&#96; Gemini integration back in line with the upstream API surface (using existing constructors) while retaining informative logs for MCP fallbacks.",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- Added the missing &#96;codex-stdio-to-uds&#96; dependency reference so the CLI links its stdio tunnel helper during release builds.",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- Normalised the DeepResearch web search user-agent string to the upstream format.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Details",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/Cargo.toml&#96;: Set &#96;[workspace.package] version = \"0.48.0\"&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-cli/package.json&#96;: Bumped &#96;version&#96; to &#96;\"0.48.0\"&#96; for the npm artefact.",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;scripts/install/global-install.ps1&#96;: Report the installed version dynamically instead of the hard-coded &#96;0.47.0-alpha.1&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/lib.rs&#96;: Added &#96;resolve_runtime_budget&#96; utility used by all CLI subcommands that instantiate &#96;AgentRuntime&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;{agent_create_cmd.rs, delegate_cmd.rs, parallel_delegate_cmd.rs}&#96;: Switched to the helper and kept token budgets as &#96;i64&#96;, matching upstream expectations.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/Cargo.toml&#96;: Declared &#96;codex_stdio_to_uds&#96; workspace dependency to restore linkage.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/cli/src/research_cmd.rs&#96;: Replaced unsupported Gemini constructors with &#96;new&#96;/&#96;with_mcp_client&#96; pattern while logging MCP intention; maintained provider fallback order.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;codex-rs/deep-research/src/web_search_provider.rs&#96;: Updated the HTTP user-agent to &#96;Mozilla/5.0 Codex-DeepResearch/0.48.0&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;cargo build --release&#96; (workspace root) — ✅ (after dependency + helper fixes).",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;scripts/install/global-install.ps1&#96; — ✅ produces globally installed CLI reporting &#96;codex-cli 0.48.0&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 23
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4197916090488434

          {
            "text": "        # Update workspace version references",
